CODEX-MERGE-ff386c6c9acf66cb: fixed. server/carriers/aras/arasClient.ts parseWellFormedXmlStructure validated tag balancing/nesting/root-count/gap-text but never inspected character data for entity-reference well-formedness. In the tag-matching scan, the inter-tag gap text is now always computed (previously only computed when stack.length===0) and validated against this helper — with any CDATA span first stripped out of the gap, since entity syntax is never processed inside CDATA (consistent with existing CDATA-opacity handling from CODEX-MERGE-a14f3b696b9f30e7/CODEX-MERGE-8222e34b89e08fa9) — before the existing outside-root whitespace-only check runs.
